jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.content: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>About Example Corp</strong></p><p>Example Corp is a made-up company for the getmeajob demo. We build billing tools for small shops&nbsp;and the people who run them.</p></div><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Design and build Python services and APIs with FastAPI</li><li>Own our Postgres schemas, migrations and query performance</li><li>Run services on Kubernetes in AWS, packaged with Docker</li></ul><h3>What we look for</h3><ul><li>3-5 years of professional experience as a backend engineer</li><li>Strong Python and Postgres skills</li><li>Experience running workloads on Kubernetes</li></ul><p>This role is fully remote and open to candidates anywhere in the world.</p>

jobs.title: Staff Platform Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Example Corp is a made-up company for the getmeajob demo. We are looking for an engineer to lead the design of our internal platform and set its direction for the next few years.</p><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Shape how every team ships and runs software</li><li>Mentor other engineers and review designs</li></ul><h3>What we look for</h3><ul><li>8+ years of experience in infrastructure or platform engineering</li><li>Deep knowledge of Kubernetes and Terraform</li><li>A record of leading large technical projects</li></ul><p>Remote, open to candidates anywhere in the world.</p>

jobs.title: Backend Engineer, Payments
jobs.content: <p>Example Corp is a made-up company for the getmeajob demo. Our payments team moves money between shops and their banks.</p><h3>What you will do</h3><ul><li>Build payment services in Python on Postgres</li><li>Work with partners on settlement and reporting</li></ul><h3>What we look for</h3><ul><li>3+ years of experience building backend services</li><li>Experience with payment systems</li></ul><p>Candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. We are unable to sponsor visas for this role.</p>

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Infrastructure
jobs.content: <p>Example Corp is a made-up company for the getmeajob demo. You will lead a team of six infrastructure engineers and own their hiring, growth and roadmap.</p><h3>What we look for</h3><ul><li>5+ years of software engineering experience, including time leading a team</li><li>Hands-on background with Kubernetes and AWS</li><li>Clear writing and calm decisions under pressure</li></ul><p>Remote, open to candidates anywhere in the world.</p>
